comparison.basis: source content SHA256 and normalized Git regular-file mode

method.binary_scope: Recorded release SHA identities are bound to the qualification reports; previously independent executable verification is not repeated here.
method.final_fence: Exact file-set and all file/directory metadata checked again after hashing. No filesystem snapshot or future immutability is asserted.
method.git_blob_sha1: SHA1(b'blob ' + decimal byte length + NUL + exact file bytes)
method.mode: Git regular-file mode 100755 when owner execute bit is set; otherwise 100644. Raw permission bits are retained separately.
method.remaining_publication_gate: Compare every A20 manifest path/blob/mode with the accepted repository source tree before applying an A26 source update.
method.source_map_sha256: SHA256 of compact key-sorted JSON without a trailing newline.
method.stable_read: Single-link regular files; O_NOFOLLOW; fstat and descriptor-relative path stat before and after complete read; fresh directory-FD walk for every inventory.
